name: Dynamic RDS
author: Nick Anderson (ShadowLight8)
description: Manage QN8066 or Si4713 FM transmitters to broadcast custom RDS messages like a real station. Reads media metadata and playlist fields. Runs on Raspberry Pi or BBB.

privacy.summary: Broadcasts the song title, artist and other text you set to FM radios nearby. Can also publish that text to your MQTT broker if you turn it on.

sends.what: the song title, artist, album and other text you set
sends.why: to show what's playing on listeners' radios

sends.what: what is being broadcast, the plugin's settings and status
sends.why: so other systems can follow what's on air

systemChanges.what: copies an example Dynamic_RDS_config.sh into FPP's scripts folder and asks FPP to restart after install
edits the Pi boot config to switch I2C mode or enable hardware PWM when you change those advanced settings
installs the python3-paho-mqtt package from Debian when you click to enable MQTT support

privacy.other: Settings pages on FPP's web server can change the boot config and install a package; they have the same protection as FPP's own pages.
